MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 7
   C. 13
   D. 12

2. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 0
   C. 16
   D. 17

3. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 40

4. Solve for x: x + 5 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 6
   C. 7
   D. 11

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 2
   C. 12
   D. 14

6. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 81

7. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

8. Solve for x: x + 8 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 8
   C. 16
   D. 8

9. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 10

10. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 1000 m²

11. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

12. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 15
   C. 21
   D. 3

13. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x < 5

14. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 11
   D. 24

15. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 24

16. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 7

17. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 24

18. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 24
   C. 25
   D. 2

19. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 73
   C. 1
   D. 72

20. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 9
   D. 82

21. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

22. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 56
   C. 1
   D. 15

23. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

24. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 13

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
